subject: Priority heatmap & decision handoff — weekly leadership readout
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: leadership-distro@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-28T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Priority heatmap & decision handoff — weekly leadership readout

Team — sending a condensed heatmap for this week (attached) with explicit decision points so we can lock on a few items before QBR prep. TL;DR: two wins, three medium-high risks, three asks. Please skim and flag any disagreement by EOD Monday.

Wins
- Hosted API latency improvements: 12% reduction p99 for gen workloads after kernel tweak; rollout to canary pool complete. (owner: infra; tracked in OPS-1298)
- Partner pilot with Acme: completed integration test plan and initial data ingest; Samantha confirmed volume profile. Next: production onboarding call scheduled Dec 2. (owner: partnerships)

Risks
- Dedicated capacity commit: legal/finance need final terms by Dec 6 or we miss Jan capacity provisioning (impact: Dedicated revenue recognition, staffing). Ask: Sales + Finance alignment on discount band by Wed 11/30. (owner: laura_bennett)
- Eval regression on davinci-legacy for key account prompts: small but consistent BLEU drop on reranker subset; risk to renewal if not mitigated. Need short-term fallback plan and long-term model retrain cadence. (owner: markus_klein)
- Procurement for GCP capacity in EU region delayed due to vendor questionnaire outstanding. If not cleared by Dec 10, EU customer SLAs may degrade. (owner: karthik_iyer)

Asks / Decision points
1) Approve temporary price protection for Dedicated pilot (one-off credit, up to $30k) to secure commit — decision needed by Wed 11/30. (proposed by: sales; decision owner: laura_bennett)
2) Approve canary fallback to davinci-stable for customers in the reranker cohort for 48 hours while we investigate. (decision owner: markus_klein)
3) Authorize procurement escalation to channel partner for EU GCP capacity if vendor questionnaire stalls beyond Dec 6. (decision owner: karthik_iyer)

Action items (consolidated)
- Laura: finalize discount band proposal and confirm decision path (due: 2026-11-30)
- Markus: run root-cause check on reranker BLEU drop and propose rollback plan (due: 2026-11-29)
- Karthik: chase procurement questionnaire; escalate to partner ops if no response by 2026-12-06
- Me: update the QBR slide pack with heatmap snapshot and revenue exposure (done: draft attached)

Attachments: Q4-priority-heatmap.xlsx (dashboard), okrs-reforecast-notes.pdf (draft reforecast), action-items-tracker.csv

Notes: I intentionally kept the doc short — see attached heatmap for links to telemetry. If we can get decisions on 1–3, QBR narrative becomes straightforward.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: leadership-distro@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-28T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Priority heatmap & decision handoff — weekly leadership readout

Marcus — thanks for the concise heatmap. Quick notes:
- On #1 (price protection): I'm okay with the credit if sales confirms ARR commitment level; will confirm by Wed morning.
- On EU procurement: will loop in procurement leads and confirm whether escalation threshold is acceptable.

One ask: can you add the expected revenue delta in the heatmap table (best/likely/worst) so Finance can sign off quickly?

Laura

Quick follow-up on the reranker regression: I ran the A/B logs overnight and saw a pattern where tokenization changes in the training pipeline correlate with the drop on the validation subset. Proposed immediate steps: rollback the tokenizer patch to stable for affected models + re-run evals; run deeper diff for candidate prompts used by the customer cohort. If we roll back, what's the window for escape hatch (how long before clients see a change)?

Also: on the Dedicated credit ask, what's the expected margin impact? If we need a bridge approval, we should get CS on the thread for any retention risk.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Serving Reliability
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the fast replies — consolidating decisions and next steps: 

Decisions made
- Temporary price protection approved up to $30k contingent on confirmed ARR by Sales. Laura to post final approval in this thread by COB 11/30.
- Fallback plan approved: markus to flip reranker cohort to davinci-stable canary for up to 48 hours while we investigate; ops to monitor error/latency impact.
- Procurement: karthik to escalate to channel partner on Dec 6 if questionnaire unresolved; leadership sign-off granted for escalation path now.

Updated action table (owner / due / status)
- Laura: post final discount approval in thread / 2026-11-30 / in progress
- Markus: rollback tokenizer patch in canary + run evals / 2026-11-30 / in progress
- Karthik: vendor follow-up + escalation plan / 2026-12-06 / monitoring
- Marcus: update QBR slides with revenue delta and final heatmap / 2026-12-01 / draft attached

I've attached an updated heatmap with a simple best/likely/worst revenue column (Q4-priority-heatmap.xlsx v2) and uploaded the action tracker to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdHeatmapQ4. Please add comments directly in the action-items-tracker.csv for any adjustments.

If there are no objections, I'll lock these items into the QBR narrative and circulate the dry-run schedule for Dec 8.

Marcus
